reason: B40 reviewed secondary web transcriptions; B41 directly inspects printed, physically photographed Vatican 1962 Missale Romanum, confirming compositional rubrics, separate Mass choices, and Gospel alternatives.

source.title: Missale Romanum — Editio Typica, Vatican 1962
source.publisherIdentification: Vatican original imprint, as scanned by Church Music Association of America and hosted on GregoBase
source.yearProof: Decretum dated 23 June 1962, with typica declaration; directly inspected scanned [III].

coverageScope: Physical image inspection of 11 specified scanned pages (title/decree plus 9 Common pages) limited to relevant structural directions, incipits, alternative readings and some orations. No claim of exhaustive printed line-by-line Latin collation of all Common components or translations.

printedRules.name: Statuit ei
printedRules.proof: First printed Confessor Pontiff Mass I is headed Pro Confessore Pontifice and begins Statuit ei Dominus.

printedRules.name: Sacerdotes tui
printedRules.proof: Separate second Mass II titled Pro Confessore Pontifice Altera Missa begins Sacerdotes tui.
First Mass Epistle headed Lectio libri Sapientiae with Ecce sacerdos magnus.
First Mass presents the parable of talents as Gospel.
Second Mass contains Beatus ille servus in Matthew 24.
Printed note recognizes an alternate Epistle and Gospel for feast of St Nicholas and another bishop context; do not silently overwrite Saint-specific assignments.

cases.warning: The two printed Mass forms and saint-specific substitutions cannot be conflated. A title alone never authorizes selecting one.

printedRules.name: Me exspectaverunt
printedRules.proof: Page [30] heads Pro Virgine et Martyre, Altera Missa, with Me exspectaverunt; page [31] plural rubric references the immediately preceding Mass (Missa dicitur ut supra).
Plural martyrs rubric on [31] expressly substitutes De virginibus, from Vultum tuum, Commune Virginum IV loco [33], rather than the prior base Epistle.

printedRules.incipit: Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster, sanctarum Virginum et Martyrum
printedRules.proof: Plural virgins-and-martyrs Collect begins with exact joint class designation.

printedRules.incipit: Intende, quaesumus, Domine, munera altaribus tuis
printedRules.proof: Immediately following plural Virgin martyrs heading, separate Secreta printed at [32].

printedRules.incipit: Praesta nobis, quaesumus, Domine, intercedentibus sanctis Virginibus et Martyribus
printedRules.proof: Postcommunio directly follows at [32].
Second Mass for virgin and martyr prints Gospel of treasure/pearl/fishing net.
Printed text expressly introduces Item alterum Evangelium; Missale Online shows this alternate Gospel only, so online page cannot exclude printed alternative.

cases.warning: Vultum tuum is source of the replacement Epistle, not the entire plural-martyrs Mass. Printed base and alternate Gospel survive; do not assume one obligatory Gospel from electronic single selection.

printedRules.name: Me exspectaverunt
printedRules.proof: Page [35] has Pro Martyre non Virgine with the Me exspectaverunt Introit.
Pro pluribus Martyribus, quae non sint Virgines: dicatur Missa ut supra, cum orationibus ut infra. It substitutes plural prayers only.

printedRules.incipit: Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster, sanctarum Martyrum
printedRules.proof: Unlike the Virgin martyr counterpart, this omits Virginum from the Collect category.

printedRules.incipit: Intende, quaesumus, Domine, munera altaribus tuis
printedRules.proof: Separate plural non-virgin Martyrs Secreta printed.

printedRules.incipit: Praesta nobis, quaesumus, Domine, intercedentibus sanctis Martyribus
printedRules.proof: Separate plural non-virgin Martyrs Postcommunio printed.
Single non-virgin martyr Mass whose text is reused contains Confitebor tibi Domine.
Single non-virgin martyr Mass whose text is reused has pearl/treasure Gospel.

cases.warning: Both plural martyr classes share Me exspectaverunt but only the Virgins group substitutes the De virginibus Epistle; the non-virgin group substitutes prayers only.

correctionToB40.originalB40Gospel: B40 tracked Matthew 19:3–12 for several Virgin Martyrs as one electronic Gospel, with separate-reading verification pending.
correctionToB40.nowObserved: The preceding Me exspectaverunt printed Mass has Mt.13:44–52 at [30], with explicit Item alterum Evangelium Mt.19:3–12 at [31]; must preserve selectable/conditional alternative in proper authority rather than hardcoding the sole online visible Gospel.

ownerConstraints: Original physical 1962 Common pages govern textual structure; ICRSP commentary labels do not.
Neither printed Common evidence nor electronic Mass pages authorizes liturgical use for an arbitrary calendar day, form or particular saint.
Mass Explorer has one read-only owner based on a certified Calendar selected Proper; do not install new chooser.
Do not copy photographed Missal pages to GitHub; keep external URL and page-level provenance; individual translations require rights review.
No current date's actual resolved Proper sourcePath or full bilingual source components has been run or matched in this research.
